groups.name: iqscaffold
groups.description: IQ Scaffold custom configuration properties for the Pipeline Service.

groups.name: iqscaffold.observability
groups.description: Observability configuration for monitoring and tracing.

groups.name: iqscaffold.observability.tracing
groups.description: Distributed tracing configuration for request tracking across services.

groups.name: iqscaffold.pipeline
groups.description: Pipeline-specific configuration properties for sales pipeline management.

groups.name: iqscaffold.services
groups.description: External service URLs for inter-service communication.

properties.name: iqscaffold.tenant-id-header
properties.description: HTTP header name used to identify the tenant in multi-tenant requests.

properties.name: iqscaffold.observability.tracing.enabled
properties.description: Enable distributed tracing for monitoring request flows across microservices.

properties.name: iqscaffold.observability.tracing.sampling-rate
properties.description: Sampling rate for distributed tracing (0.0 to 1.0). 1.0 means trace all requests, 0.1 means trace 10% of requests.

properties.name: iqscaffold.observability.tracing.endpoint
properties.description: OTLP endpoint URL for sending trace data (e.g., to Jaeger, Tempo, or other OpenTelemetry collectors).

properties.name: iqscaffold.pipeline.enable-auto-stage-progression
properties.description: Enable automatic progression of deals through pipeline stages based on predefined rules and triggers.

properties.name: iqscaffold.pipeline.enable-follow-up-reminders
properties.description: Enable automated follow-up reminders for deals that require attention or action.

properties.name: iqscaffold.pipeline.enable-activity-tracking
properties.description: Enable tracking of all activities and interactions related to pipeline deals.

properties.name: iqscaffold.services.lead-service-url
properties.description: Base URL of the Lead Service for inter-service communication and lead data retrieval.

values.description: Low sampling - trace 10% of requests (production recommended)
Manual stage progression - users must manually move deals through stages
Automatic stage progression - deals move automatically based on rules
Docker Compose or Kubernetes service name
